package rulefixtures

import (
	"fmt"

	"go.uber.org/zap"
)

// scenario for string_format_in_structured_logger: `logger.Info(fmt.Sprintf("user %s logged in", user))` instead of structured fields
// fixture polarity: positive; family: library; severity: info.

func scenario430Positive(logger *zap.Logger, username string) {
	logger.Info(fmt.Sprintf("user %s logged in successfully", username))
	logger.Warn(fmt.Sprintf("user %s has 3 failed login attempts", username))
}
